PIXEL FLOW

Tap the pigs. Clear the pixels. Feel the flow.

How to play
  • Tap the front pig of a lane to send it onto the conveyor.
  • Pigs automatically shoot cubes of their own color that face them — outer cubes shield inner ones.
  • The number is ammo. Empty pigs leave happily.
  • Pigs with ammo left after a lap hop into the 5 waiting slots. Tap them to relaunch.
  • The conveyor has limited capacity. If a pig returns and every slot is full — game over!
